sn50.45-54:1.1: cattārome bhikkhave, oghā. katame vattāro: …pe… bhāvetabbānīti. 6. 5. 40. uddhambhāgiyasuttaṃ pañcimāni bhikkhave, uddhambhāgiyāni saṃyojanāni.
sn50.45-54:1.5: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya pañca balāni bhāvetabbāni.
sn50.45-54:1.7: idha bhikkhave, bhikkhu, saddhābalaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn50.45-54:1.11: paññābalaṃ bhāveti vivekanissitaṃ virāganissitaṃ nirodhanissitaṃ vossaggapariṇāmiṃ.
sn50.45-54:1.12: imesaṃ kho bhikkhave, pañcannaṃ uddhambhāgiyānaṃ saṃyojanānaṃ abhiññāya imāni pañca balāni bhāvetabbānīti.
sn50.45-54:1.13: oghavaggo pañcamo. tatruddānaṃ: ogho yogo upādānaṃ gantho anusayena ca, kāmaguṇā nīvaraṇā khandhā oruddhambhāgiyāti.
